prompt: Use case: stylized automotive concept presentation for an engineering design review. Create one high-quality landscape design sheet for a radical Porsche 993-era inspired sports coupe project, without Porsche logos or badges and without copying a specific photograph. The attached technical packaging sheet is the governing reference for proportions and architecture. Show a clean three-quarter rear exterior rendering plus a precise semi-transparent cutaway side inset. Essential mechanical layout: two-seat cabin; rear seats removed; longitudinal air-cooled flat-12 twin-turbo engine entirely ahead of the rear axle line in a rear-mid-engine position; compact longitudinal transaxle extends behind the rear axle; visibly stretched wheelbase concentrated between the B-pillar and rear wheel by approximately 450 mm; rear overhang remains restrained, not a long tail. Wide rear fenders, functional side cooling inlets behind the doors, rear deck ventilation, motorsport stance, plausible structural firewall behind seats. Make the rear axle line visually explicit in the cutaway so it is unmistakable that the engine mass is in front of it and the gearbox is behind it. Styling: professional 1980s/1990s industrial design marker rendering blended with modern photorealistic clay-model presentation, warm off-white paper background, graphite body, burnt-orange engine, cyan-blue transmission, restrained burgundy datum lines. No readable labels, no dimensions, no watermark, no brand marks, no people. Avoid putting the engine behind the rear wheels. Avoid a front-engine layout. Avoid a four-seat cabin. The result is concept art only; do not imply production readiness.
